dct_description_sm: Kilpisjrvi Biological Station is situated in the mountain birch forest zone near the 70th degree of northern latitude (6903'N; 2050'E) in the northwesterenmost part of Finland. Station belongs to University of Helsinki, the Faculty of Biological and Environmental sciences. Long-term follow-up studies form the core of the research activities at the station.
dct_title_s: Phenological phenomena, yearly variation in production and seed crop of selected alpine plants in Lapland, Finland
